body.name: input-determined support-aware handle
body.construction: The support-aware handle takes the finite input \(I=(G^{+},H,A,a,Y,p_H)\), the retained normalized carrier, and the fixed encodings.  Its work multiset exposes the explicit Start, District, Fix, A2, Factor, Join, and Residual tasks.  Its only choices are finite graph computations, canonical least valid fixing sequences, canonical supported contexts and Algorithm-2 triples, and canonical residual candidates.  Selector handling is performed by context-graph construction; truncated factorization, CADMG fixing, ancestor marginalization, district spawning, and joining remain distinct operations.  Every formula division is recorded in the step-indexed ledger, and no successful published trace, identifying formula, target fiber equality, or oracle agenda is an input.
